whatIsIt.eli5: A Bottleneck whose first helper has two windows that are merged later.
whatIsIt.simple: A Bottleneck whose first Conv is a RepConv (3×3 and 1×1 in parallel during training).

whyExists.simple: The extra branch helps training; it is merged away for deployment.

simple: RepConv: 3×3 Conv+BN plus 1×1 Conv+BN, added, then SiLU.
engineer: Fusion: pad 1×1 to 3×3 and sum kernels/biases.
